Business Requirement Description: Display a centralized Home Dashboard showing high-level business metrics.
Secure navigation sidebar linking to all core functional modules (Quotes, Jobs, Schedule, Timesheets, etc.).
Display statistical KPI cards summarizing operations (e.g., active jobs, pending timesheets).
Ability to view a paginated, search-enabled list of all service/product catalog items.
Ability to create new catalog items, defining unit prices, descriptions, and categories.
Ability to edit existing catalog items to reflect pricing or description updates.
Ability to import large pricebook datasets in bulk.
Maintain a searchable CRM database of all active and archived customers.
Ability to create new customer profiles, capturing contact and billing information.
Ability to update or archive existing customer records.
Ability for Franchise Managers to view the complete staff roster.
Ability to add new team members, defining their roles and default hourly pay rates.
Ability to deactivate/reactivate staff members based on employment status.
Generate distinct Quotes pulling pricing data from the Pricebook.
Edit and update Quotes before they are sent or approved by the customer.
Generate formal Invoices linked to finalized interactions, tracking payment fulfillment.
Record payments against Invoices to update their status from Outstanding to Paid.
Convert accepted Quotes into active operational "Jobs".
Display a master list of all Jobs with filtering by status or client.
Provide a detailed drilled-down view of a specific Job's requirements and history.
Learning Service: Create base service templates defining the structure and rules of an offering.
Session (Recurrence): Generate recurring schedules (e.g., Every Monday for 10 weeks) based on a Learning Service.
Session Slots: Manage the individual generated slots (e.g., "Monday, Oct 2nd Class"), handling staff overrides or cancellations.
Enroll and track specific attendees enrolled in either the Master Session or individual Slots.
Provide a full calendar view of all upcoming scheduled Session Slots branch-wide.
Individualized "My Calendar" view showing only the specific Session Slots assigned to the logged-in staff member.
Staff View: Allow staff to view their personal timesheets and submit actual working hours.
Manager Inbox: Display an inbox for Managers to review all pending timesheets from staff.
Financial Engine: Auto-calculate total pay (Actual Hours * Hourly Rate).
Discrepancy Alerts: Visually flag when a staff member submits "Actual Hours" that differ from the Session Slot's "Estimated Hours".
Approvals: Allow Managers to efficiently Approve or Decline timesheet entries, updating the payroll status.
Account security management including Changing Passwords, updating profiles, and toggling strict MFA.
Create custom system Roles, assign members, and map specific permissions from the Permission Tree.
Multi-site management enabling the creation, updating, and global viewing of Franchise Tenants.
Configure and update core Payment Gateway integrations for the branch.
Advanced Quote lifecycle actions including Sending to Client, Cloning Quotes, Exporting PDFs, and modifying ad-hoc prices.
Ability to view historical Payment Logs and securely Cancel previous payments.
Bulk Import and Export of massive Customer CRM datasets via CSV.
Securely view and manually override direct Staff Pay Rates independently of default unit roles.
Export formal timesheet data streams to external banking integrations (Xero/API).
